hedge_exemplars.value: If Rule 184 has any state for W in 5..11 with a transient > W or a cycle > 2, the separating property is insufficient.
The right-permutativity property might be insufficient to explain the behavior, if rule 30 (which is also right-permutative) is observed to fail for small W despite the property.
If simulation of rule 110 or rule 184 for any W in [5,11] shows ALL initial states reach a cycle of length <=2 within 4*W steps, then nonlinearity alone is insufficient as a separating property.
